task: Close source-free generic return types through the typed semantic summary
observation: An imported from_range(data) helper returned an owned Vector[Int] from a Range input, while its interface retained `_generic:data`. Publishing the non-Method Iterable requirement made the stale display return relation appear complete and bound the consumer result back to Range. The source-free foundations acceptance then failed; a compiler-path typed summary probe showed the incorrect relation before native lowering.
impact: The repository-wide check stopped in the source-free foundations acceptance. A summary built from the checked body return now projects Vector[Int] and the source-free consumer prints 329 after provider source removal.

resolution.summary: Use the inferred closed body return TypeRef when it contradicts a legacy `_generic` display relation; keep open requirements and concrete specialization on the same typed summary.
